method.frame_selection: Predicted frames 1..100, t=0.04..4, equal time weights; initial frame excluded
method.transform: scipy.fft.dctn(type=2,norm=ortho), separately along two spatial axes, no mean subtraction or window
method.definition: E(kx,ky) = mean_t |DCT(error)|^2 / N^2; velocity sums both cell-centered component powers. Transform error fields, not differences of field power spectra.
method.shell_definition: Sum modal powers for floor(sqrt(kx^2+ky^2))=j; plotted x is mean radial index of modes in that shell; shell 0 is DC
method.physical_scale: q=sqrt(kx^2+ky^2); cosine wavenumber pi*q/L, nominal wavelength 2L/q for q>0; L=1
method.ratio_definition: Mean SOL error power / mean uncorrected error power; below1 improves. Shell ratios omitted only if baseline shell power <1e-8 times that solver/field total baseline MSE. Raw values retained in JSON/CSV.
limitations: Cosine basis diagnostic for closed walls, not a periodic Fourier energy spectrum or a solver eigenmode decomposition.
Cell-centering attenuates highest staggered velocity modes. Vector MSE here is not the original normalized training loss.
64x64 resolved scales only; fine reference first restricted128to64. Different solvers use different fine references.
One held-out trajectory and one selected model per backend; no uncertainty estimates.
Band boundaries predefined descriptive labels, not inferred physical inertial/dissipation regimes.

display_conventions: Curves show nonzero modes only. DC remains in raw data and band totals, and is summarized separately. Power axis linear below 1e-11; logarithmic above. Ratio axis logarithmic. CSV ratio_above_threshold describes eligibility, including DC, not whether drawn.
